description: Change a market map the account owns or co-authors, in plain words, the way the chat in Market Map Maker does: 'move Cyera to Growth Stage', 'add a section of voice AI', 'remove Acme', 'make it dark', 'sort by funding', or a pasted list of companies with an instruction above it. Takes map_id from create_market_map or get_market_map. The change is saved to the same map, so the editor and any public page show it. Returns the same fields as create_market_map, including status: when it is 'building', call get_market_map until it is 'done'. Uses one market map credit only when the edit adds companies; style and layout edits are free. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

instruction.description: What to change, in plain words. A long pasted list is fine: put the instruction above it.

map_id.description: The map to change (map_id from create_market_map or get_market_map).

name: edit_market_map
title: Edit a market map
